text:
maria: quick heads-up — perf run on canary shows host-side CPU tail dominated by smallwrite syscall bursts during tokenization and grpc frame commits. attaching flame sample.

oliver: ouch, any numbers?

maria: p50 host parse CPU 12ms -> 28ms on 2k reqs/sec. top stacks show: tokenize_small_write -> grpc_writev -> poll -> syscall

noah: could be write aggregation missing. are we flushing on every chunk? what about writev coalescing config?

maria: We traced: stream preflight sends 4-8 byte frames per token when streaming-on; proxy not coalescing. Perf snippet:

```
perf top -p 1234
  tokenize_small_write  42.1%
  grpc_writev           18.4%
  kv_cache_lookup       7.3%
  memcpy                6.2%
```

maria: Also KV cache hit rate dropped ~3% during the same load — eviction spike aligns with many tiny requests for short prompts.

oliver: Hmm batching heuristic may be mispredicting seq lengths. Are we using the dynamic-batcher v2? It currently groups by model only.

noah: Right now it bins by model+seq_estimate; but seq_estimate is based on token_count header from client which is flaky. Proposal: use prefix-length estimation from first 32 bytes instead (cheap heuristic).

maria: Also saw grpc half-close jitter — clients opening ~2k streaming connections -> many small TLS record writes. Short-term mitigation: enable socket write coalescing at proxy (SO_SNDBUF tweak) and enable writev aggregation in rust-proxy (flag: rpc.writev_coalesce=true).

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: rust-proxy/enable-writev in canary at 2026-03-24T10:00Z

oliver: Can we add a micro-bench for writev that simulates 1-8 byte writes at 4k conns?

noah: I'll add the bench and follow-up with measurements. If writev helps but KV hit drop remains, we need to adjust eviction TTL for streaming sessions to avoid the prefix-KV eviction spiral.

maria: Action items:
- noah: add writev microbench + upload results
- oliver: patch rust-proxy flag and run canary
- maria: add prefix-length estimator hook and A/B it vs header approach
- infra-bot: Canary deploy scheduled

maria: TL;DR host-side overhead dominated by syscall/write bursts when streaming token-by-token + KV eviction spiral due to short sessions. Short-term: writev coalesce + proxy sndbuf tweak. Medium: batching heuristic fix + prefix estimator.
